title: Contrastive Explanations in Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2609.02399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Argumentation frameworks are useful tools for representing and reasoning with information in a variety of settings, e.g. in supplementing AI models as they perform classification tasks, with a notable benefit of providing additional explainability. In this paper, we introduce contrastive explanations for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks (QBAFs), one such formalism. Unlike most existing explanations for QBAFs, which explain the reasoning outcome of a single argument of interest (i.e. a topic argument), contrastive explanations explain the difference between two topic arguments. We introduce a general form of contrastive attribution functions (CAFs) and establish a set of general properties they should satisfy. We introduce CAFs based on removal, gradients and Shapley-values, and study their properties. translated_title: 量化双极论证框架中的对比解释
translated_abstract: 论证框架是在多种场景下表示和推理信息的有用工具，例如在AI模型执行分类任务时为其提供辅助，其显著优势在于能够提供额外的可解释性。本文为量化双极论证框架（QBAFs）这一形式化方法引入了对比解释。与QBAFs大多数现有解释（即解释单个关注论证，也称为主题论证的推理结果）不同，对比解释解释的是两个主题论证之间的差异。我们提出了对比归因函数（CAFs）的一般形式，并建立了它们应满足的一组通用性质。我们引入了基于移除、梯度和Shapley值的CAFs，并研究了它们的性质。最后，为了展示对比解释的作用，我们在医疗保健和偏见识别场景中证明了它们的实用性。
tldr: 本文为量化双极论证框架（QBAFs）引入了对比解释这一新概念，用于解释两个主题论证之间的推理差异，提出了对比归因函数的一般形式以及基于移除、梯度和Shapley值的三种具体实现，并在医疗保健和偏见识别场景中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces contrastive explanations for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks (QBAFs) to explain the difference between two topic arguments, proposing a general form of contrastive attribution functions (CAFs) with implementations based on removal, gradients, and Shapley values, and demonstrating their usefulness in healthcare and bias identification settings.
